entities.summary: Bredäng is a district of Skärholmen, Stockholm, Sweden in the Söderort section of the city. It is named after a former farm in the area. Bredäng has an 18th-century mansion named after its first owner, Jacob Graver. Bredäng consists predominantly of 1960s apartment blocks and has a camping site by the lake Mälaren.
